question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 5.5 years at 4% per annum rate of interest.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate = Rate × Time

⇒ Effective rate = 4% × 5.5 = 22%

⇒ Simple Interest = 22% of Principal

⇒ SI = 22% of 400 = 88

**∴ The correct answer is ₹88.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹400

Rate (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 5.5 years
